aceforce-asmr.name: ACEFORCE ASMR
aceforce-asmr.bio:
Fast mouth sounds and tapping, usually with no talking, in videos that run long: most pass the half hour mark and the middle sits around three quarters of an hour. The sounds are quick and repetitive, and the titles lean on games and internet jokes. It suits listeners who want a single long session to leave running rather than a short clip to sample.

Start with ASMR Fast Mouth Sounds Minecraft Parkour Spiral Speed Run, fourteen minutes, if you want to test whether the fast mouth sounds work for you before committing to a long one. ASMR For Deaf People runs twenty two minutes and is built on tapping, for a change of texture. ASMR Fast Mouth Sounds Roblox Speed Run Walter White is the long option, close to an hour and a half, for falling asleep with something that will not end soon.

Skip it if eating sounds bother you, since a small share of the catalog uses them, or if you want quiet, slow, deliberate sounds, because the mouth work here is fast and constant. Look instead for a channel built on soft speaking and slow hand movements, or one with short ten minute videos if you prefer a quick session.

We have 157 of their videos, uploaded between 2020 and 2026, and the unusual thing in our data is how little they talk: almost none of it is spoken, which is rare for a channel this size.

alb-in-whisperland-asmr.name: ALB in whisperland ASMR
alb-in-whisperland-asmr.bio:
This channel is mostly soft speaking and whispering, often with keyboard typing in the background, and the videos are long, with many running over an hour. It suits listeners who want to settle in for a long session and prefer a voice that talks them through rather than pure silence.

Start with "Extremely Relaxing Keyboard Typing ASMR (no speaking)" for a wordless, steady typing session that runs about an hour and a half. If you want to test the whispering, try "Ring Ring! Whisperland Survey Calling (ASMR soft spoken + keyboard typing)", a shorter mix of voice and typing. For a quiet page turning session, "ASMR Book Flip Through (whisper + paper sounds, tracing) Barbie: The World Tour" is a gentle option.

Skip it if you dislike long videos or want mostly silent triggers, since most here run over half an hour and talking is common. Instead, look for channels that focus on no talking and short sessions, or that use triggers like tapping and crinkles without voice.

We have only 16 videos in our catalog, a sample of the channel, with uploads from 2012 to 2026.

asmr-anil-cakmak.name: ASMR Anil Çakmak
asmr-anil-cakmak.bio:
Almost all real barber shop massage: head, face, shoulder and ear massage, often with haircuts and shaves on camera. Videos usually run around twenty minutes, and very few pass half an hour. It suits listeners who like watching a real treatment unfold, with clippers, razors and hands rather than whispering.

Start with "ASMR Instant Asmr Sleep Massage | ASMR HEAD MASSAGE", a typical length head massage that shows whether this style works for you. For the full barber visit, "ASMR | Real Barber Shop Treatment - ASMR Head Massage, Asmr Beard Cut" adds cutting and grooming sounds. If you want something to fall asleep to, "ASMR MASSAGE | Even The Room Got Tired And Fell Asleep" keeps the pace slow.

Skip it if you want a voice talking to you, or long videos for a full night, since most end well before an hour. Birol Erdin ASMR offers a similar barber massage format. TOKYO ASMR MASSAGE is an option if you want massage filmed in a different style and setting.

Our catalog holds 564 of their videos, uploaded between 2018 and 2026.

asmr-annie.name: ASMR Annie
asmr-annie.bio:
Inaudible whispering with long nails tapping and scratching, ear to ear and often for hours. Videos usually run around 26 minutes, with many long sleep videos past two hours. It suits listeners who want wordless whispering and slow nail sounds to sleep through.

Start with ASMR EXTRA SLOW & RELAXING (Clicky Whispers with Slow Tracing, Tapping, Scratching) to test the style in a normal length video. If you want a whole night, the BINAURAL INAUDIBLE WHISPERING WITH GENTLE EAR CUPPING video runs for hours. For deep relaxation, the DEEP RELAXATION video with fluffy mic, whispering and shhh sounds is another long option. Start with the shorter one if you are unsure, then try the long videos at bedtime.

Skip it if you want to understand what is said, because most whispering is inaudible. Skip it too if long nails or ear blowing sounds bother you, since they come up often. Rynsey ASMR offers faster, clearer whispering, and Chels ASMR pairs soft whispering with back scratching.

Our catalog holds 265 of their videos, uploaded between 2020 and 2026.

asmr-bakery.name: ASMR Bakery
asmr-bakery.bio:
Almost all no-talking sound videos, mostly tapping, and very long: a typical video runs well over an hour. You hear objects, hands and microphones, not a voice or a story. It suits listeners who want a sound bed to sleep or study to without anyone speaking.

Start with "ASMR for People Who Need DEEP SLEEP (No Talking)", one of the shorter videos here, to see whether the sound style works for you without committing to a whole night. If it does, "The Ultimate Tapping ASMR 3 Hours (No Talking)" keeps steady tapping going until morning, which suits anyone who wakes when a video ends.

Skip it if you like a voice, roleplay or personal attention, because there is almost none here, or if you want something short to fit into a lunch break. Headphones Recommended ASMR is another no-talking channel worth comparing. Vanukee ASMR is an option if you want a similar quiet approach with different objects.

This is a sample of the channel: our catalog holds 46 of their videos, uploaded between 2018 and 2026.

asmr-berlin.name: ASMR Berlin
asmr-berlin.bio:
Fast and aggressive tapping, scratching and brushing, with quick roleplays like haircuts and a few very long sleep videos. Videos usually run around half an hour. It suits listeners who want high energy triggers to break through tingle immunity, or a long night session.

Start with ASMR For Deep Spine Tingles | Ear to Ear, Anticipatory to test whether the close ear to ear style works for you. Try ASMR Fast Haircut and Style for a quick roleplay with clips, curling and spray sounds. If you want the full fast experience, ASMR To Turn Your Brain OFF | FAST AND AGGRESSIVE shows the channel at full speed.

Skip it if fast and aggressive sounds make you tense, because many titles lean that way. Skip it too if you want slow whispering, since there is little of it. ASMR Glow mixes mic scratching with calmer whispering, and Alexa ASMR offers steady scratching and tapping with no talking. The long sleep videos are the exception.

Our catalog holds 85 of their videos, uploaded between 2024 and 2026.

asmr-darling.name: ASMR Darling
asmr-darling.bio:
Mostly soft-spoken roleplay and close personal attention, with videos that usually run around half an hour and often go longer. You hear whispering, tapping, hair play and the occasional brush against the microphone, all aimed at winding you down rather than startling you. It suits listeners who want a calm, talky session before sleep and don't mind a bit of make-believe.

Start with ASMR 20 Triggers To Help You Sleep, an hour of tapping that gives you a long runway into the night. If you want something shorter and more focused, try ASMR Relaxing Scalp Massage for hair play at a comfortable length, or ASMR Ear to Ear Whispering if you are testing whether the whispering voice works for you.

Skip it if mouth sounds bother you, since one of the more prominent videos leans on them, or if you would rather have silent, sound-only sessions than roleplay with talking. Instead, look for a channel built around quiet tapping or brushing with no speaking at all, or one that keeps every video very short; nothing here is that brief.

We have only 17 of their videos in our catalog, uploaded between 2016 and 2021, so this is a sample of the channel rather than the whole thing.

asmr-darya.name: ASMR Darya
asmr-darya.bio:
Whispering and personal attention, with face touching, back tracing and soft-spoken scenes, in videos that often run around half an hour. Many titles mix English and Russian. It suits listeners who want slow, close attention and a calm voice for a full evening session.

Start with "ASMR FACE TOUCHING for sleep and relaxation", a shorter video that quickly shows whether gentle hand sounds and close attention work for you. For tracing and scratching sounds, "ASMR / АСМР Amazing Back Tracing, Scratching and more..." stays slow and quiet. If you want something longer with outdoor sound in the background, "ASMR / АСМР to get tingles, sleep and relaxation" mixes nature sounds into the session.

Skip it if you want new uploads, since the newest videos in our catalog date back a few years, or if you prefer pure sounds without roleplay, because some titles set up interrogation or dramatic scenes. Egilea ASMR offers a similar whispered personal attention style. beez asmr is another option if you want gentle attention with different trigger choices.

Our catalog holds 142 of their videos, uploaded between 2015 and 2022.

asmr-glow.name: ASMR Glow
asmr-glow.bio:
A mix of whispering, personal attention, mic scratching and gentle positive affirmations, in long videos that often pass half an hour. Many are trigger assortments that change sounds every few minutes. It suits listeners who get bored with one sound and want variety while they wind down.

Start with "ASMR Brain Massage (Intense Mic Scratching)", a shorter session that shows quickly whether close mic scratching gives you tingles. For a slower night, "ASMR Comforting Sounds For Anxiety & Bad Moments (Very Soft Mic Scratching)" keeps the same sound much softer. If you want a full evening of variety, "ASMR 50 Triggers for ∼2H of Tingles" moves through many objects in one long video.

Skip it if you want one consistent sound for a whole session, since most videos jump between triggers, or if you dislike lots of mic contact. Valeriya ASMR offers similar trigger mixes in shorter videos. Egilea ASMR is another choice if you want a calmer whispered pace.

This is a sample of the channel: our catalog holds 38 of their videos, uploaded between 2016 and 2026.

asmr-home-jp.name: ASMR HOME JP
asmr-home-jp.bio:
This channel is built around head and shoulder massage sessions, usually with tools and ice spray sounds rather than hands alone. Videos run around seventeen minutes on average, most of them silent or near silent, and a good share stretch past the half hour mark. It suits listeners who want steady, repetitive scalp and ear work to wind down with, and who prefer sound over talk.

Start with 【ASMR】Tingles Head Massage/ ICE Spray for the plainest version of what the channel does, short enough to try before bed. If you want the spray element on its own, 【ASMR】ICE Spray Head Massage / bubble ice braek sounds / Stimulates the scalp runs about 11 minutes and gives you the crackle without the full massage. For a longer session, HEAD MASSAGE / Tingles/Using Two Tools runs about sixteen minutes and shows how the tool work carries a video.

Skip it if you want variety: massage dominates the catalog, and the rest is a thin scatter of spraying, tapping and scratching. Skip it too if talking or roleplay is what settles you, since there is almost none here. Look instead for a channel that mixes many triggers evenly, or one built on whispered roleplay, if either of those is what you need.

Our catalog holds 55 of their videos, uploaded between 2022 and 2024, so this is a sample of the channel rather than everything.

asmr-loopz.name: ASMR Loopz
asmr-loopz.bio:
Soft spoken loops, mostly an hour long, built from existing footage rather than a host in a studio. Most videos are unintentional formats: exams, massages, library visits. It suits listeners who want a long, quiet background for sleep and do not need a face or direct address.

Start with "ASMR Loop: Hand and Reflex Exam - Unintentional - Soft Spoken - 45 mins" for a shorter first listen that shows the soft spoken loop style. "ASMR Loop: ASMR Legend Lita - Massage Compilation - 1 Hour" is for falling asleep to a full hour of massage sounds. "ASMR Loop: Sir David Attenborough - Unintentional ASMR - 1 Hour" if you want nature narration as a sleep background.

Skip it if you want new, original recordings or short clips under ten minutes, since every video here runs over half an hour. Also skip if you dislike soft spoken loops that repeat the same source material. Instead, look for channels that make original, shorter ASMR videos with a visible host and a mix of triggers.

Our catalog holds a sample of their videos, with uploads spanning a few years.

asmr-mood.name: ASMR MOOD
asmr-mood.bio:
A Russian-language channel with tapping, close whispering and personal attention, often in long videos made as background for sleep or study. Videos usually run around half an hour, and many sleep videos go much longer. It suits Russian speakers, or anyone who enjoys whispering without needing the words, who want long, steady sessions.

Start with "ASMR БЛИЗКИЙ ШЕПОТ для СНА 3 часа АСМР | Close-Up Whispers" if you want close whispering long enough to cover a whole night. For a shorter test, "ASMR for when You're Lonely" is a typical length video with a gentle, comforting scene.

Skip it if you need to understand the talking, since most videos are spoken in Russian, with subtitles on only some of them. Also skip it if you want one clear trigger, because the sounds vary a lot between videos. Jinx ASMR offers a similar close whispering style. ASMR Berlin is another option if you want long sessions with different triggers.

Our catalog holds 192 of their videos, uploaded between 2019 and 2026.

asmr-node.name: ASMR Node
asmr-node.bio:
This channel leans on whispering and tapping, usually wrapped in roleplay setups like an eye exam or a haircut, and most videos run around twenty minutes. The tone stays quiet and attentive rather than chatty, so it suits listeners who want a calm, guided session with a personal feel before sleep or during a break.

Start with ASMR: Cranial Nerve Examination - Traditional Role Play if you want close personal attention carried through a full roleplay, or ASMR: Brushing and Counting (Whispered) if gentle brushing and counting sounds are more your pace. When you have longer to spare, ASMR: Q&A - Answering Your Questions! runs well past half an hour for an unhurried listen.

Skip it if roleplay framing or constant whispering wears thin, since those shape most of what is here, and eating sounds appear only occasionally. Instead, look for a channel built around silent visual triggers or one that mixes in more tapping without a scripted scenario.

Our catalog holds only 28 of their videos, a sample of the channel, spanning uploads from 2016 to 2020.

ppomo-asmr.name: ASMR PPOMO
ppomo-asmr.bio:
Long, slow trigger sessions: breathing, keyboard typing, whispering, hair brushing, tapping and liquid sounds. Every video in our sample runs past half an hour, many with no talking. It suits listeners who want something long and steady for sleep or study.

Start with ASMR Close Inaudible Whispering with Ear Triggers to test whether close, wordless whispering works for you. If you need background for studying, the keyboard video with fast typing and no talking runs well over an hour. For sleep, ASMR All of Slow Triggers for Relaxation and Sleep keeps the pace low the whole way.

Skip it if you want short videos or clear speech, because most sessions are long and the whispering is not meant to be understood. Heavy breathing sounds also appear often, which some listeners dislike, and there is little variety in pace. Valeriya ASMR offers shorter, faster trigger videos, and Rynsey ASMR is another option to compare.

Our catalog holds 33 of their videos, uploaded between 2016 and 2024, so this is a sample of the channel.

asmr-rebecca.name: ASMR Rebecca
asmr-rebecca.bio:
Mostly personal attention and soft speaking, in videos that usually run around a quarter of an hour. You will hear close whispers, writing sounds, and the occasional light pattern, with some talking and some quiet stretches. It suits listeners who want a calm, friendly voice to ease them toward sleep or relaxation.

Start with "A Very Realistic ASMR Eye Exam" for a full personal attention session that runs long enough to settle into. "ASMR My Most Realistic Cranial Nerve Exam Yet" is even longer, if you want to stay in that scenario. For a shorter taste, try "ASMR Light Triggers for Heavy Eyes" to see how the visual triggers work for you.

Skip it if you want mostly silent videos, because many here include soft-spoken guidance. Also skip if you prefer very short clips, since most videos run well past ten minutes. Instead, look for a channel that focuses on no-talking triggers or one that offers quick, under-five-minute sessions.

Our catalog holds 55 of their videos, uploaded between 2023 and 2026.

Skip this channel if you prefer short videos or need talking to stay engaged, since almost everything is long and silent. Instead, look for creators who mix talking with triggers or offer shorter sessions under 10 minutes, and who cover triggers beyond hair and scalp work.

asmr-sharm.name: ASMR Sharm
asmr-sharm.bio:
Mostly tapping and hand movements, with whispering and mouth sounds, often fast and unpredictable. Videos usually run around 20 minutes. It suits listeners who want lively, varied triggers and roleplays rather than a slow, steady sleep track.

Start with ASMR, Slow & Relaxing Hand Movements W/ UNPREDICTABLE TRIGGERS to test the style at a gentler pace. If you want something long for sleep, ASMR, Sleep Clinic (WORLDS MOST TINGLIEST COLLAB) is a longer roleplay with other creators. For a quick, high energy test, ASMR, FAST AND AGGRESSIVE MAKEUP APPLICATION shows the fast side of the channel. Between them you will know quickly whether the faster side or the slower side suits you.

Skip it if fast or aggressive triggers make you tense, because many titles promise them, or if mouth sounds bother you. Some titles also use rough, comedic roleplay themes. Dido ASMR offers calm tapping during long card games, and Hanna Bee 🐝 leans on slower whispering and hand movements.

Our catalog holds 424 of their videos, uploaded between 2019 and 2026.

asmr-twix.name: ASMR Twix
asmr-twix.bio:
Soft spoken voice, often in Japanese, over long sessions that usually run around three quarters of an hour or more. Most videos are quiet talking rather than sound effects, and several are filmed in Tokyo salons and clinics where the camera follows a real treatment. It suits listeners who want a calm voice to sit with for a long stretch, not a quick burst of tapping.

Start with "ASMR Doing Your Makeup (Soft Spoken Japanese)" if you want to test whether the quiet Japanese talking works for you before committing to a long one. Skip it if you need short clips, since nothing here comes in under ten minutes and most run past half an hour. Skip it too if you want pure sound triggers with no talking, because the voice carries nearly every video. Look instead for channels built on tapping, crinkling or silent treatments, or for shorter soft spoken sessions if you only have a few minutes.

We have only 18 of their videos in our catalog, uploaded between early 2021 and mid 2026, so this is a sample of the channel.

asmr-magic.name: ASMRMagic
asmr-magic.bio:
Long tapping and scratching sessions, often with no talking, using binaural mics, ear cleaning tools, wood and cork. Every video in our sample runs past half an hour, and the median is around 71 minutes. It suits listeners who want pure, close ear to ear sound for sleep or study.

Start with ASMR Tascam Mic Tapping W/ Scratching (NO TALKING) to test whether gentle, close mic sounds work for you in about an hour. If you want a whole night, the Triggers over Hours (NO TALKING) upload mixes ear cleaning, massage, tapping and peeling. For sharper textures, ASMR Wood Triggers (NO TALKING) focuses on scratching and clicky wooden sounds.

Skip it if you want talking or short videos, because nearly everything is long and silent. Skip it too if ear cleaning sounds make you uneasy, since they appear in several uploads. Dido ASMR adds soft talking and card games to its tapping, and ASMR Sharm is another option to compare.

Our catalog holds only 26 of their videos, uploaded between 2016 and 2021, so this is a sample of the channel.

asmrrequests.name: ASMRrequests
asmrrequests.bio:
This channel is built around binaural role plays and soft speaking, and most videos run well past half an hour. You hear close, ear to ear sound with gentle talking over it, not silence. It suits listeners who want a long, immersive session with a bit of a story to follow rather than a quick burst of sound.

Start with "An Esthetician Visit" for a forty minute face massage role play that shows off the binaural style. "Thrifty Thursday: Face Brushing" runs longer and leans on brushing and soft speaking, good if personal attention is what settles you. "Bedtime Fairy Tales" mixes reading, page turning and tapping, which makes it the one to try if you want something to fall asleep to.

Skip this channel if you want short clips, since nothing here comes in under ten minutes, or if role play scenarios put you off and you would rather have plain sound. Look instead for creators who keep videos brief and skip the talking, or who work with a single trigger rather than a staged scene.

We have only 23 videos in our catalog, uploaded between 2013 and 2019, so this is a sample of the channel.

abby-asmr.name: Abby ASMR
abby-asmr.bio:
Abby ASMR is mostly soft-spoken personal attention, often built around medical roleplays like cranial nerve and eye exams. Videos usually run around twenty-five minutes, and most of them include talking. It suits listeners who want a calm, guided session before sleep rather than plain sound triggers.

Start with ASMR Cranial Nerve Exam While You Sleep for a full-body medical roleplay that runs over half an hour, a natural first listen if you want to be talked down to sleep. If you only have a few minutes, try ASMR Fast 5 Minute Cranial Nerve Exam to test whether the format works for you. For something quieter and language-focused, ASMR In German offers writing and repeating words over a longer session.

Skip this channel if you prefer silent triggers with no talking, or if medical roleplay themes feel odd to you. Instead, look for creators who work mostly with tapping, no-talking sound sessions, or ambient noise without a roleplay frame.

Our catalog holds 94 of their videos, uploaded between 2021 and 2026.

adventure-of-the-viper-asmr.name: Adventure of The Viper
adventure-of-the-viper-asmr.bio:
Rain on canvas, wind against a hot tent, and a dog moving around camp: that is most of what you hear here, in videos running around twenty minutes or longer. There is no whispering and no roleplay, just recorded weather and camp ambience. It suits listeners who want rain and storm sound with a real outdoor scene behind it, and who like a session long enough to fall asleep to.

Start with Hot Tent Camping in Heavy Rain All Day! for the plainest version of the format, steady rain around a tent for falling asleep. 2 Days in the Forest in Heavy Rain! adds forest and flood sounds if you want the rain broken up by other weather. If you have two hours, The Most Insane Rain Camps in Heavy Rain with My Dog! runs long enough to cover a whole night.

Skip it if you want quiet, controlled studio rain, since these are field recordings with wind, dogs and campsite noise. Skip it too if you need short clips, because nothing here is under ten minutes and some run past two hours. Look instead for a channel of indoor rain recordings with no talking and fixed lengths.

Our catalog holds 36 of their videos, uploaded between 2022 and 2026, with rain in most of them and a handful of snow and forest sessions.

Start with Scratching the Insomnia Out of Your Brain to test whether close scratching and whispering work for you. For a full night, You will be asleep by the end of this ASMR is built to play until morning. Pick the shorter scratching video first if you are unsure, then move to the long ones.

Skip it if you want short videos or fast triggers, because almost everything here is slow and long. Skip it too if you want a story, since there are few roleplays. Telina ASMR focuses more on clicky whispering and rambles, and WhisperAudios ASMR offers whispered medical and haircut roleplays.

For sleep, Asmr Mic Scratching, Brain Scratching with Mics runs for an hour with no talking. If you only have a few minutes, the Testing Your Tingle Immunity Levels upload is short and intense.

Skip it if you want whispering, roleplay or soft voices, because there is almost no talking here. Skip it too if sharp nail scratching on the mic feels harsh to you. ASMR Glow mixes scratching with whispering and roleplay, and ASMRMagic offers even longer tapping and scratching sessions. Very short videos are uncommon as well.

Our catalog holds 740 of their videos, uploaded between 2020 and 2026.

amy-kay-asmr.bio:

asmrprog.name: AsmrProg
asmrprog.bio:
This is a coding channel with the sound turned into the point: keyboard clatter, mouse clicks and the small noises of building a web page, with no voice at all. Videos usually run around twenty minutes, though a fair number stretch past half an hour. It suits listeners who want something to half-watch while their hands are busy, or who find typing sounds easier to sleep to than whispering.

Start with ASMR Programming - Calculator App Coding - No Talking, a half-hour build that gives you the typing rhythm without asking anything of you. If you want to test whether the format holds your attention, ASMR Programming - Weather App With Javascript - No Talking runs about twenty minutes, close to the channel's usual length. For a long session, ASMR Programming - Coding IOS (IPhone) Dynamic Music - No Talking runs well over an hour.

Skip it if you need a voice, a face or a story, because there is almost none of that here, and if you want soft triggers like brushing or whispered roleplay this will sound like an office instead. Look instead for a silent typing or keyboard channel that keeps the camera on the screen, or a whispered coding channel if you want commentary over the work.

We have 145 of their videos in our catalog, uploaded between 2022 and 2025.

birol-erdin-asmr.name: Birol Erdin ASMR
birol-erdin-asmr.bio:
Real massage sessions in a barber chair: head, back, face and ear massage, hair washing and some back cracking, with little talking. Videos usually run around 21 minutes, and almost none pass half an hour. It suits listeners who like watching calm, hands on treatment as a short wind down before bed.

Start with ASMR OBEN | Head-Back Massage On Chair, PRE-SLEEP TREATMENT if sleep is your goal, since it stays slow and steady. Try ASMR RELAXING CHAIR MASSAGE | SLEEP THERAPY FROM MELEK for a similar chair session with a different therapist. If you are curious about the cracking sounds, the BACK CRACKING & MASSAGE video with narration and subtitles explains what is happening.

Skip it if back or neck cracking makes you wince, because it appears in some uploads, or if you want close mic triggers like tapping and whispering. Skip it too if you need a long video for the whole night. TOKYO ASMR MASSAGE offers longer, quieter Japanese barber sessions, and ASMR Anil Çakmak is another barber massage channel to compare.

bonfire-ambience-asmr.name: Bonfire Ambience
bonfire-ambience-asmr.bio:
A fire and nothing else: crackling logs against a black screen, no talking, no music, no voice. The videos are built to run for hours, most of them far past the length of an ordinary evening, so you can start one and forget it. It suits listeners who want a room to sound occupied while they sleep, read or work, and who would rather not touch the screen again.

Start with Crackling Fire at Night Dark Background Video, which runs a full twelve hours and needs no attention after you press play. Night Fire in the Dark Background Video is the same idea at a slightly shorter stretch, good for a night when you expect to wake and want the sound still going. If you only want the fire for an evening, Relaxing Fireplace (3 Hours) with Burning Logs and Crackling Fire Sounds ends on its own before bed.

Skip it if you want variety, since almost every video is the same fire and the same black screen, or if you need something short, because there is nothing here under ten minutes. Look instead for a channel that mixes fire with rain, wind or other ambiences, or one that offers shorter sessions you can fit into a lunch break.

Our catalog holds 134 of their videos, uploaded between 2021 and 2026.

brad-mcbride-asmr.name: Brad McBride
brad-mcbride-asmr.bio:
Rain and weather soundscapes, almost all of them running well past an hour, with no talking at any point. The mood is steady and unbroken, closer to a window left open than to a produced track. It suits listeners who want one long file to carry them through the night rather than a playlist of short clips.

Start with Rain on a Tent Sounds, an eight hour rain recording that gives you a full night from a single play. Dark and Stormy Night runs two hours and adds thunder, which is the quicker way to find out whether the stormier end of the channel works for you. If wind is more your thing, Winter Wind is another eight hour file and a fair test of the nature side.

Skip it if you want short sessions or guided whispering, since nothing here is brief and nothing is spoken. Skip it too if you need variety inside a single video, because these are one continuous sound for hours. Look instead for a channel that mixes spoken triggers with sound, or one built around ten to twenty minute clips you can choose between.

Our catalog holds only 19 of their videos, a sample of the channel, uploaded between 2012 and 2015.

brazilian-adventure-asmr.name: Brazilian Adventure

calmed-by-nature-asmr.name: Calmed By Nature
calmed-by-nature-asmr.bio:
Rain, fire, ocean and meadow sounds, usually running for hours rather than minutes, and almost always with music or cafe chatter folded in. Nothing here is spoken to you directly. It suits listeners who want a room to leave on all night or all afternoon, not a guided session.

Start with Cozy Cabin Ambience - Rain and Fireplace Sounds at Night 8 Hours for Sleeping, Reading, Relaxation for rain over a fire, the combination most of the channel is built around. Rainy Night Coffee Shop Ambience with Relaxing Jazz Music and Rain Sounds for jazz and cafe murmur if you want something less empty than plain weather. Relaxing Meadow with Ambient Nature Sounds, Wildflowers, and Mountain View is the one to try if rain and fire feel too close and you want open air instead.

Skip it if you want short videos, silence, or a person whispering to you: every video here runs long, and the sound is scenery rather than company. Skip it too if jazz or cafe noise would pull your attention. Look instead for a channel of shorter, voice led sessions, or one that keeps rain and fire bare without music underneath.

All 140 videos in our catalog run past half an hour, uploaded between 2017 and 2026, which is the widest span and longest median we hold for a nature channel.

chels-asmr.bio:
Mostly soft whispering over back scratching, tracing and light touch massage, often framed as a classmate drawing games on your back. Videos usually run past half an hour, with a median around 32 minutes. It suits listeners who like slow, repetitive touch sounds and gentle voices to settle into sleep.

Start with ASMR | The Girl in Class That Scratches Your Back | Tracing, CrissCross, Counting Freckles to test whether the back drawing games work for you. If you want simple sound with less story, ASMR Back Scratch With Tracing keeps the focus on the scratching itself. For a full night, the long version of The Girl in Class Scratches Your Back runs for hours and adds hair play.

Skip it if you want crisp tapping or fast changes, because the pace here is slow and the same back attention themes repeat across many uploads. Skip it too if you dislike whispered talking, since a voice runs through most videos. Rynsey ASMR is another option to compare, and ASMR Glow mixes in more mic scratching and mouth sounds with fewer roleplays.

denmas-hengki-asmr.name: DenMas Hengki
denmas-hengki-asmr.bio:
This channel is almost entirely heavy rain, recorded outdoors while someone builds shelters and camps. Videos run long, around half an hour or more, and there is no talking, just the rain and the work. It suits listeners who want a steady, natural soundscape for sleep or deep relaxation, and who like the idea of watching a shelter come together.

Start with SOLO CAMPING HEAVY RAIN - BUILD SHELTER IN LONG HEAVY RAIN - ASMR for a typical session that shows the shelter build and the rain. If you have more time, SOLO BUSHCRAFT HEAVY RAIN - BUILD A UNIQUE SHELTER - RELAX AND ENJOY THE SOUNDS OF NATURE runs longer and gives you more rain to sink into. For a shorter test, try SOLO CAMPING HEAVY RAIN - STRUGGLE TO SET UP A TENT IN NON STOP RAIN - ASMR, which is under half an hour.

Skip it if you want variety in triggers, because rain dominates almost everything here, or if you prefer short videos, since none are under ten minutes. Instead, look for a channel that mixes rain with other sounds like fire or tapping, or one that offers shorter sessions.

In our catalog, 51 of their videos appear, spanning from June 2022 to August 2026.

dido-asmr.name: Dido ASMR
dido-asmr.bio:
Tapping and soft whispering while playing card tricks, board games, puzzles and maths problems. Many videos are very long, and the median runs around half an hour. It suits listeners who like a calm, focused activity on screen and want something steady to fall asleep or study to.

Start with [ASMR] Mind Reading Tricks! to test whether the card handling and quiet talking work for you in a shorter sitting. If you want to leave something running all night, the long CARD MAGIC upload keeps the same gentle shuffling and tapping for hours. For something more like a story, [ASMR] Casino Roleplay adds a dealer character to the card sounds.

Skip it if you want intense triggers or close ear sounds, because the pace is slow and much of the sound comes from cards and game pieces. Skip it too if you dislike hearing someone think out loud while solving puzzles. ASMR Sharm is another option to compare, and asmr zeitgeist leans harder into tapping without the games.

Our catalog holds 1182 of their videos, uploaded between 2018 and 2026.

Skip it if you dislike rain sounds in every video or if you want short sessions, since none are under half an hour. Instead, look for a channel with a mix of triggers and shorter lengths, or one that reads without background sound.

dr-alex-tubio-asmr.name: Dr. Alex Tubio
dr-alex-tubio-asmr.bio:
This channel is built around chiropractic adjustment sounds: sharp cracks, pops, and the occasional Y strap, presented as a kind of bodywork ASMR. Videos usually run around twenty minutes, and most include talking, with the doctor explaining or reacting. It suits listeners who find joint cracking satisfying and want a session that feels like a treatment rather than pure sound.

Start with "ASMR Chiropractic: 40 Explosive Neck Crack Compilation" for a straightforward introduction to the cracking sounds. "*TUBIO LIFT* LOUDEST CRACKS COMPILATION" offers a denser run of pops if you want more in less time. "PARALYZED MAN'S LIFE RESTORED BY 1ST CRACK!" shows the channel's story-driven style, where the adjustment is framed as a dramatic rescue.

Skip this channel if you dislike eating sounds, since a small share of videos include them, or if you prefer silent, trigger-focused sessions without commentary. Instead, look for creators who specialize in pure tapping or whispering with no talking, or who avoid medical-style roleplay and keep things quiet and simple.

We have a large catalog of their videos, uploaded between 2019 and 2026.

eden-asmr.name: Eden ASMR
eden-asmr.bio:
Mostly soft-spoken massage roleplays, where a character in an everyday setting gives you a massage while talking you through it. Videos usually run around twenty minutes, with some long series. It suits listeners who like a story and a calm voice alongside massage sounds.

Start with "Massage from Airbnb Host - ASMR", a shorter roleplay that shows quickly whether the talking and massage mix works for you. If it does, "Door-to-door Massage Sales - ASMR" uses the same format with a lighter, sillier setup and a similar length.

Skip it if you want no talking or pure sounds, since most videos are scripted scenes with a voice throughout. Some titles also set up odd or dark scenarios, such as strangers entering your home or a kidnapping series, which may not suit a calm bedtime. ASMR Anil Çakmak offers real hands-on massage with barely any talking. LaLek ASMR is another option if you want a different roleplay style and setting.

eevy-asmr.name: Eevy ASMR
eevy-asmr.bio:
Mostly tapping and scratching on unusual surfaces: concrete, ice, camera bodies and phone cases, often recorded outdoors. Videos usually run around 17 minutes, many with little or no talking. It suits listeners who want textured, sometimes fast tapping instead of whispering.

Start with ASMR in the rain, concrete scratching, camera taps to test whether outdoor tapping with rain in the background works for you. If you want something long to leave running, ASMR: Concrete scratching & tapping only! Invisible triggers, No talking is the longest upload in our list and stays quiet. For a short, fast burst, try the Lofi camera/phone tapping video with different phone cases.

Skip it if you prefer slow, gentle triggers, because some videos are fast and aggressive, or if you want whispering and personal attention. Outdoor recordings also carry some background noise like rain and animals. asmr zeitgeist is another tapping channel to compare, and Dido ASMR pairs tapping with card games and puzzles in much longer videos.

Our catalog holds 823 of their videos, uploaded between 2019 and 2026.

egilea-asmr.name: Egilea ASMR
egilea-asmr.bio:
Cosplay roleplays with soft whispering and personal attention, based on game, anime and TV characters. Videos usually run around 26 minutes, with plenty of soft speaking. It suits listeners who enjoy fandom characters taking care of them in a gentle story.

Start with ASMR School Nurse Tender Care and Medical Check-Up to test the soft spoken care style without needing to know any fandom. If you know the game, ASMR Lady Dimitrescu and Her Daughters Welcome You to the Family is a long, theatrical roleplay. For a busier scene, Welcome to Our Chaotic Family, Arcane ASMR Roleplay adds brushing and group characters.

Skip it if you do not follow the source shows or games, since many roleplays assume you know the characters. Skip it too if creepy themes are not for you, because a few titles lean toward horror. WhisperAudios ASMR offers whispered medical and haircut roleplays without fandom, and Telina ASMR focuses on clicky whispering and rambles.

Our catalog holds 130 of their videos, uploaded between 2021 and 2026.

This channel is mostly personal attention roleplay, with Emily speaking softly to you in videos that often run close to half an hour. It suits listeners who want a calm, spoken presence to fall asleep to rather than silent trigger montages, and who are happy to settle in for a longer session instead of a quick one.

Start with "asmr personal attention to help you fall asleep" for a 20-minute session that sets the tone. If you want no talking at all, try "asmr triggers to help you fall asleep... (no talking)" at 33 minutes. For a quick taste, "asmr gf takes you to the beach" runs only 7 minutes.

Skip it if you dislike roleplay framing or prefer very short videos, since most here are longer and many are personal attention. Instead, look for a channel built around silent triggers or brief sessions with no talking, where the focus stays on sounds rather than a spoken scenario.

We have only 15 of their videos in our catalog, a sample of the channel.

food-code-asmr.name: FooD Code ASMR

This channel is built almost entirely around spray bottle sounds, and most videos run long, around half an hour or more, which makes them easy to leave playing as you drift off. gongsam-table-asmr.name: GONGSAM TABLE 이공삼
gongsam-table-asmr.bio:
Every video here is eating: convenience store fire noodles, tteokbokki, hot dogs, cheese pizza, fried chicken and seafood. Videos usually run around 16 minutes and almost none are shorter than ten. It suits listeners who want saucy, chewy Korean meals with no talking in a short sitting.

Start with the FIRE Noodle & HOT DOG & GIMBAP EATING SOUND! video to hear noodles, rice rolls and crispy hot dogs in one go. Try the FRIED CHICKEN AND BLACK BEAN NOODLES upload if you want crunchy coating and slurpy noodles. For a shorter session, the TRUFFLE OIL BLACK BEAN NOODLES & FRIED CHICKEN video is one of the briefer uploads.

Skip it if you dislike chewing, slurping or spicy food sounds, because there is nothing else on the channel and no long sleep videos. Many uploads repeat the same convenience store menu. SIO ASMR adds colorful honey jelly desserts, and 설기양SULGI covers similar meals with homemade recipes. Talking and whispering are absent, too.

Our catalog holds 1151 of their videos, uploaded between 2018 and 2026.

Half of what you hear is someone giving you their full attention: hair cutting, spa treatments, massage, close personal care, usually whispered. The other half is tapping and small sounds. Videos run long, around half an hour or more, and none in our catalog are under ten minutes. It suits listeners who want a long, quiet session with a person attending to them, not a quick burst of sounds.

Start with ASMR FAZENDO VOCÊ RELAXAR INTENSAMENTE E DORMIR BEM NO SPA, the longest of the most watched at forty six minutes, for a full session that carries you toward sleep. ASMR CORTE DE CABELO COM ARREPIOS GARANTIDOS is the personal attention format at its clearest, if you want to test whether that style works for you. If you prefer sound over scenario, TE ARREPIANDO ATÉ VOCÊ CAIR EM SONO PROFUNDO ASMR leans on tapping for a shorter, simpler listen.

Skip it if you want variety in triggers: personal attention and tapping dominate, and mouth sounds, spraying and brushing appear only now and then. Skip it too if you dislike whispered Portuguese titles and roleplay framing, since most videos are built around a scenario. Look instead for a channel that mixes many triggers evenly, or one with silent, sound only videos and shorter lengths.

Our catalog holds 111 of their videos, uploaded between 2017 and 2026, with almost all aimed at relaxation and tingles rather than sleep.

gentle-whispering-asmr.name: Gentle Whispering ASMR
gentle-whispering-asmr.bio:
Soft spoken and whispered roleplays with tapping, crinkling, page turning and towel folding, many framed as spa visits, haircuts or personal attention. Most videos run past half an hour. It suits listeners who want a calm, kind voice and slow pacing for sleep.

Start with Fluffy Sleepy Whispers ASMR to test whether the whisper style works for you without a roleplay in the way. If you want a full story, Sleep-inducing Haircut ASMR adds shampoo, page flipping and scissors over a long session. For pure sound with fewer words, TAPS for YOUR NAPZzz keeps the focus on tapping.

Skip it if you prefer fast, intense triggers or no talking at all, since a gentle voice runs through most uploads. Many videos are older recordings, so the sound can differ from newer channels. Expect long sessions rather than quick samples, and plenty of roleplay framing. Rynsey ASMR is another option to compare, and Gibi ASMR mixes in faster, more varied roleplays. Some roleplays also use playful, made up words that not everyone enjoys.

Our catalog holds 147 of their videos, uploaded between 2011 and 2026.

ges-asmr.name: Ges ASMR
ges-asmr.bio:

Start with La chica del fondo del salón está OBSESIONADA contigo (Parte 2) for a mid length tapping video with a story frame, or Estilista RARA se COME tu CABELLO + MASAJE capilar profundo if you want a longer session with mouth sounds and hair play. For a quick test of the style, try Tu amiga con BRACKETS se COME tu CABELLO en clases, which is shorter and focuses on hair play.

Skip this channel if you dislike mouth sounds or eating noises, since they appear in about a fifth of the videos, or if you want mostly silent triggers, as soft speaking is present in many. Instead, look for a channel with a higher share of silent tapping or scratching and fewer roleplay titles.

asmr-gibi.name: Gibi ASMR
asmr-gibi.bio:
Mostly personal attention roleplays, from medical exams to tailors and flight attendants, plus typing and tapping. Videos usually run around twenty-five minutes, and some are fast-paced role switches. It suits listeners who like being the center of a scene with a voice talking them through it.

Start with "The Cranial Nerve Exam - ASMR", a long, slow exam roleplay if you want to fall asleep to one steady scene. To test whether the fast style works for you, try "Fastest ASMR | Tailor, Haircut, Drawing You, Face Paint, Allergist, Librarian, Barista, Grocery, Bar", which changes roles every minute or so. If you prefer sound over story, "[ASMR] Dark & Relaxing Tapping & Scratching [Close Whispers]" keeps the talking low.

Skip it if you want no talking at all, since most videos are roleplays with dialogue, or if quick scene changes keep you awake. Tingting ASMR offers slower personal attention in much longer sleep sessions. Goodnight Moon is another choice for a calmer, quieter pace.

Our catalog holds 110 of their videos, uploaded between 2016 and 2026.

ginger-asmr.name: Ginger ASMR

Soft spoken personal attention roleplays: suit fittings, eye exams, shaves, facials and spa visits, many filmed in sharp video. Videos usually run around 22 minutes. It suits listeners who want a calm character to look after them before bed.

Start with ASMR Relaxing Shave & Face Massage if sleep is the goal, since it is built for deep relaxation. Try ASMR Orbital Eye Exam to test whether detailed medical attention with light tests works for you. For a pampering session, Paris Spa ASMR mixes massage, facial and soft talking. Each one keeps a gentle pace and a soft voice from start to finish.

Skip it if you want pure sound with no character, because nearly every upload is a roleplay with a voice. Skip it too if spit painting or flirty scenes are not for you, since a few titles use them. Latte ASMR offers longer, slower nurse and spa roleplays, and Alexandria ASMR leans into comedy roleplays.

goodnight-moon-asmr.name: Goodnight Moon
goodnight-moon-asmr.bio:
Soft spoken and whispered roleplays with personal attention, rain, typing and gentle rambles, many with cozy or fantasy settings. Most videos run past half an hour, with a median around 36 minutes. It suits listeners who want a calm voice and a little story to drift off to.

Start with ASMR Forest Lodge Hotel Check-in (Raining, Typing, Soft Speaking) to test the soft spoken roleplay style with rain in the background. If you just want a voice and weather, Rambles in the Rain (asmr) is a relaxed talk with rain sounds and no script. Both are gentle entry points before trying the more character driven videos.

Skip it if you dislike roleplays where a character fusses over your face, because many titles repeat that theme with intense, obsessive characters. Skip it too if you want short clips, since few uploads finish quickly. Gibi ASMR offers faster, more varied roleplays, and Catplant ASMR mixes soft speaking with tapping and massage sounds.

Our catalog holds 190 of their videos, uploaded between 2018 and 2026.

hanna-bee-asmr.name: Hanna Bee 🐝
hanna-bee-asmr.bio:
Mostly mouth sounds, spit painting and whispering, in very long videos: a typical one runs over two hours. Expect clicky, close-mic sounds with hand movements. It suits listeners who already know they like mouth sounds and want a session that lasts the whole night.

Start with "ASMR Super sensitive mouth sounds", a short video that tells you within minutes whether this sound works for you or grates on you. If it works, "ASMR Clicky Mouth sounds with Hand movements Face touching" adds visual hand movements to the same trigger. For a softer, more spoken option, "ASMR Crispy Trigger words Slow with Hand Movements" relies on whispered words instead.

Skip it if mouth sounds bother you, since they lead most videos here, or if you want short videos, since most run far past an hour. Wahonay ASMR offers similar close mouth sounds in much shorter videos. Jules ASMR is another option if you prefer a faster, more aggressive style with mic scratching.

harryasmr.bio:
This channel is mostly personal attention, with cranial nerve exams and makeup sessions making up the bulk, plus a steady amount of tapping. Videos usually run around ten minutes, and most include talking rather than silence. It suits listeners who want a quick, friendly session with a voice guiding them toward rest, not a long silent soundscape.

For a first listen, try "Super Sleepy ASMR Cranial Nerve Exam" if you want a long personal attention session aimed at sleep. "Doing Your Makeup With My Mom!" is a short tapping video for a quick break. "My Family Tries ASMR For The First Time!" offers a tapping session with several voices, useful if you want to hear how the talking sits with you.

Skip this channel if you prefer long silent videos, since most run under ten minutes and few go past half an hour. Also skip it if personal attention roleplay like cranial nerve exams does not work for you. Instead, look for creators who stay silent and build long tapping or whispering sessions without a scenario.

Our catalog holds 172 of their videos, uploaded between 2024 and 2026.

hatomugi-asmr.name: Hatomugi ASMR
hatomugi-asmr.bio:
Japanese whispering and no talking videos built around ear cleaning, ear massage, tapping and slime sounds, recorded with binaural mics. Most videos run past half an hour, with a median around 37 minutes. It suits listeners who want soft, close ear sounds for sleep.

Start with the Japanese ASMR Sounds for Sleep & Relaxing whisper video with English subtitles to test whether the whispering works for you. If you prefer silence, [ASMR] Ear Cleaning / No Talking keeps to close ear sounds. For a gentle roleplay, the Oil Ear Massage Roleplay adds casual Japanese whispering. Each one runs long enough to settle into before sleep.

Skip it if ear cleaning sounds make you uneasy, because they come up in many uploads, or if you want short videos, since few finish in under ten minutes. Most whispering is in Japanese. Rynsey ASMR is another option to compare, and Chels ASMR offers whispering over back scratching in English. Expect slow pacing throughout.

Our catalog holds 357 of their videos, uploaded between 2015 and 2025.

headphones-recommended-asmr.name: Headphones Recommended ASMR
headphones-recommended-asmr.bio:
Fast and aggressive tapping, hand sounds and random triggers, often lofi and with no talking. Videos usually run around 11 minutes, and many are shorter. It suits listeners who want quick, unpredictable bursts of sound to snap out of tingle immunity.

Start with FAST & AGGRESSIVE ASMR NO TALKING VERY UNPREDICTABLE RANDOM TRIGGERS LOFI to test the style with no voice. If you only have a few minutes, the Fast & Aggressive ASMR Camera Tapping, Visual Triggers, Hand Sounds video is short and focused on tapping. Both give a fair picture of what the channel does.

Skip it if fast sounds make you tense, because almost every title promises speed and surprise. Skip it too if you want long videos for sleep or a calm voice, since almost none pass half an hour and there is little talking. ASMR Bakery offers long, slow tapping with no talking, and Eevy ASMR does tapping on unusual surfaces at a gentler pace.

Our catalog holds 338 of their videos, uploaded between 2020 and 2026.

hongyu-asmr.name: Hongyu ASMR 홍유
hongyu-asmr.bio:
Colorful dessert eating is the core here: popping boba, jewel jelly, wax bottles, kohakuto candy and the occasional seafood boil. Videos usually run around ten minutes, and about half are shorter than that. It suits listeners who like crunchy, poppy candy sounds in a quick session.

Start with ASMR RAINBOW DESSERTS 무지개 먹방 팝핑보바, 보석젤리, 별사탕 먹방 to hear popping boba and jelly with no talking. Try ASMR BLUE DESSERTS with snowball marshmallows and wax bottles if you want sharper bites and crunch. If you want a wider mix of textures in one sitting, ASMR GALAXY FOODS with honeycomb, mermaid tails and jelly noodles moves from waxy to chewy to crunchy.

Skip it if you want long videos for sleep or any whispering, because the channel is almost all short eating clips with no voice to guide you. Sugary candy sounds dominate, so savory food fans may get bored quickly. SIO ASMR offers similar honey jelly desserts in slightly longer videos, and 설기양SULGI sticks to savory meals like chicken and noodles.

Our catalog holds 1021 of their videos, uploaded between 2018 and 2026.

hunnibee-asmr.name: HunniBee ASMR
hunnibee-asmr.bio:
Mainly eating sounds with colorful candy, desserts and fast food, with titles in English and Korean. Videos usually run around 16 minutes, with a little tapping and whispering in a handful of uploads. It suits listeners who want crunchy, sticky sweets and themed color challenges in a short session.

Start with ASMR *PURPLE FOOD* JELLY DONUT, PEEPS, CANDY CORN, POPPING BOBA to hear a wide spread of textures in one sitting. Try ASMR WATERMELON CAKE, BUBBLE TEA, CAKE POP, MACARON if you prefer softer bites and creamy sounds. If crunchy and cold is what you want, ASMR KITKAT SALTED CARAMEL ICE CREAM, TWIX, HAZELNUT pairs chocolate snaps with ice cream.

Skip it if you dislike chewing sounds or want long videos to sleep to, because very few uploads pass half an hour. Some titles are loud challenges, so the energy is higher than calm whisper channels. JaeYeol ASMR 재열 sticks closer to ice cream and honey jelly, and SIO ASMR mixes desserts with savory Korean dishes.

Our catalog holds 676 of their videos, uploaded between 2017 and 2026.

inaudible-asmr.name: Inaudible ASMR
inaudible-asmr.bio:
Inaudible ASMR is built almost entirely on close, clicky whispering while reading, and the videos are long: most run past half an hour, with a median around forty minutes and several stretching to multiple hours. There is no silent tapping here, just a voice kept low and soft over pages. It suits listeners who want one long whisper session to leave running until they fall asleep, and who like the reading format rather than roleplay.

Start with 3 HOURS INAUDIBLE READING ASMR | clicky whispers, word tracing, page turning if you want the full format in one go, long enough to carry you through the night. If you only want to test whether clicky whispers work for you, try INAUDIBLE READING ASMR | super clicky mouth sounds, word tracing, page turning, which leans harder on mouth sounds. For a shorter first listen, ASMR - 3 HOURS INAUDIBLE READING *clicky whisper* is the plainest version of the same idea.

Skip it if you dislike mouth sounds, since a share of the catalog leans on them, or if you want short clips, because nothing here runs under ten minutes. Look instead for a channel that mixes tapping, rain and other triggers in shorter sessions, or one with silent, no-talking videos if the whispering is too much.

Our catalog holds a sample of their videos, uploaded between 2021 and 2026.

jaeyeol-asmr.bio:
Ice cream, honey jelly and candy eaten close to the mic make up almost the whole channel. Videos usually run around ten minutes, with Korean, English and Japanese words in the titles. It suits listeners who want soft, cold, slurpy bites and crunchy jelly in a short sitting.

Start with ASMR ICE CREAM BLUE PORORO JELLY RECIPE PARTY, the longer of the two Pororo uploads, to hear homemade honey jelly next to ice cream. Try ASMR ICE CREAM PINK BLUE PARTY if you want a mix of jelly candy and creamy scoops. If you only have a few minutes, ASMR CLEAR HONEY JELLY FOOD RECIPE PARTY is short and focused on glassy jelly crunch.

Skip it if you dislike cold, wet eating sounds or need long videos, since only a few uploads pass half an hour. Many uploads repeat the same ice cream and jelly theme, so variety is limited. Spice ASMR is another eating channel to compare, and SIO ASMR covers similar honey jelly desserts alongside savory dishes.

Our catalog holds 1369 of their videos, uploaded between 2016 and 2026.

This channel is built around scalp checks and hair play, usually in videos around fifteen minutes long, and most of them involve quiet talking rather than silence. It suits listeners who like close personal attention and a slow, methodical inspection format, and who want a session that ends before it gets too long.

Skip it if you want variety, since nearly everything here is the same scalp check setup, or if you dislike the lice and dandruff framing in the titles. Look instead for a channel with a wider mix of triggers, or one that stays silent, if talking during the session distracts you.

jinx-asmr.name: Jinx ASMR
jinx-asmr.bio:
Tapping and soft whispering with scratching and mic triggers, and a run of sleep focused videos. Videos usually run around 18 minutes. It suits listeners who want gentle reassurance and simple triggers to fall back asleep.

Start with ASMR | Repeating "Shh, It's Okay" & "Go Back To Sleep" if you woke up and need to settle again. Try ASMR | Making You Fall Asleep for a calm scratching session at bedtime. If you want more energy, ASMR | Slow + Aggressive Mic Pumping, Scratching, Tapping shifts between gentle and strong sounds. All three are short enough to try in one evening and see which style fits you.

Skip it if dark roleplays bother you, because some titles use kidnapping and crime themes. Skip it too if you want very long videos, since few uploads pass half an hour. Dido ASMR offers calm tapping during long card games, and ASMRMagic has long tapping and scratching sessions with no talking.

Our catalog holds 184 of their videos, uploaded between 2019 and 2026.

jocie-b-asmr.name: Jocie B ASMR
jocie-b-asmr.bio:
This channel is mostly personal attention and positive affirmations, often built into makeup, spa, and hair play roleplays. Videos usually run long, with many over half an hour, and most include talking. It suits listeners who want to feel cared for during a lengthy, chatty session before sleep, and who enjoy being spoken to rather than left with pure sound.

Start with "ASMR Friend Pampers You" for a long, layered personal attention session that helps you wind down at night. "ASMR Hair Brushing & Scalp Massage (For Sleep)" is a shorter hair play video if you want to test scalp sounds for sleep. "ASMR Doing Your Makeup" is a faster, more aggressive makeup roleplay if you prefer quicker, tingly triggers.

Skip it if you dislike a lot of talking or roleplay with fantasy themes like mermaids and fairies. Instead, look for channels that focus on silent tapping or pure sound triggers without personal attention scenarios, and check whether their videos are short or long before you commit.

We have 70 of their videos in our catalog, uploaded between 2019 and 2026.

kevinasmr.name: KevinASMR
kevinasmr.bio:
KevinASMR is built almost entirely around one scenario: a haircut, delivered at speed, with clippers, scissors and hands close to the ears. Most videos run around sixteen minutes, and a large share of them have no talking at all, so what you hear is the cut rather than a voice guiding you through it. It suits listeners who want personal attention without a story, and who like a session that ends before they have fully settled.

Start with ASMR Ultra Fast Haircut (NO TALKING) for a first listen that shows the fast format without committing to a long sitting. If you want the full experience, ASMR 1 Hour Haircut At Different Speeds runs close to an hour and lets you compare speeds in one go. For something to fall asleep to, ASMR 2 Hours Of Super Fast Haircuts For Maximum Tingles is the longest thing here and barely needs a second tap.

Skip it if you want variety, because haircuts dominate and other sounds appear only now and then. Skip it too if you need a voice: the quiet videos are genuinely quiet, and the talking ones are a minority. Look instead for a channel that mixes many triggers in one video, or one built around whispering and soft speaking if a voice is what settles you.

Our catalog holds a few hundred of their videos, uploaded across a span of years, which makes this a broad sample rather than a handful.

laurasmr.bio:

Our catalog holds 148 of their videos, uploaded between early 2019 and 2026, and the Spanish titles throughout are the clearest sign of who this is made for.

lowe-asmr.name: Lowe ASMR
lowe-asmr.bio:
Lowe ASMR is mostly tapping and mouth sounds, with a good amount of scratching, in videos that usually run around eighteen minutes. Some are whispered, some are not, and a few stretch to an hour. It suits listeners who want a steady, mid length session with a playful streak rather than a quiet, uniform soundscape.

Start with ASMR Whispering YOUR Favorite Trigger Words In 35 Different languages for a long whispering session that carries you toward sleep. ASMR but... it's Minecraft is a shorter mouth sounds video if you want to test whether that trigger works for you. ASMR NOOB VS PRO VS HACKER ASMRTIST runs twenty seven minutes of tapping and gives you a longer stretch when you have time to settle in.

Skip it if mouth sounds put you off, since they turn up in about a fifth of the videos, or if you want mostly long sessions, because only a small share pass half an hour. Look instead for a channel built almost entirely on one quiet trigger, such as pure tapping or silent scratching, with longer run times and no talking.

Our catalog holds 190 of their videos, uploaded between late 2020 and 2026.

For a whispered option, "[ASMR] Whispering Ear Cleaning, Ear massage, Triggers For Sleep (Binaural LIVE)" is a long recorded livestream.

Skip it if ear cleaning sounds bother you, since they appear in many videos, or if you want short videos, because most run far past an hour. Whispered parts are often in Japanese. marno-asmr.name: Marno ASMR
marno-asmr.bio:
Marno ASMR is mostly tapping and whispering, with plenty of personal attention, in videos that usually run around twenty minutes. Some are silent, some are fast and unpredictable, and a few stretch past half an hour. It suits listeners who want a calm, varied session that leans toward sleep without being strictly quiet all the way through.

Start with ASMR Personal Attention and Positive Affirmations for a gentle, talking session that sets the tone. If you like a little unpredictability, try Pleasantly Unpredictable ASMR [No. 15], a half-hour video that keeps you guessing. And for a long, whisper-heavy wind-down, ASMR Hand Sounds Practice (Fast & Aggressive) (+ Unintelligible Whispers) (Looped) runs almost an hour.

Skip it if you want only silent videos, since talking and whispering appear often, or if you dislike fast, unpredictable sounds. Instead, look for a channel that is mostly no-talking and slow, with longer videos and fewer roleplay-style titles.

We have 100 of their videos in our catalog, uploaded between 2019 and 2026, and nothing in that span is shorter than ten minutes.

massageasmr.name: MassageASMR
massageasmr.bio:
MassageASMR is mostly crinkling and tapping, often in long videos that run well past half an hour, and many have no talking at all. It suits listeners who want a long, steady session for sleep or deep relaxation, and who prefer sound over chatter.

Start with "ASMR 10 Hours of Tapping, Crinkle & Trigger Sounds - No Talking Just Sounds" if you want an all night background that you never have to restart. For a shorter test of the brushing style, try "ASMR Binaural Brushing 2.1 - Massage your Brain ** Strong Sounds **" at around three quarters of an hour. If you want to check whether whispering works for you, "ASMR Mastercrafted Inaudible Whispering to Help Sleep" is a shorter session of soft, unclear words.

Skip it if you dislike crinkling sounds, since they appear in about half the videos, or if you want short clips, because only a few are under ten minutes. Instead, look for a channel with more variety in triggers and a mix of short and long videos, or one that focuses on whispering rather than crinkling.

Our catalog holds a sample of their videos, uploaded between 2013 and 2026.

mattastic-asmr.name: Mattastic ASMR
mattastic-asmr.bio:
Whispering and soft speaking lead most videos, with tapping and binaural audio woven through, and episodes usually run close to half an hour. Many are character roleplays, so you often hear a voice in character rather than plain trigger sounds. It suits listeners who like a story with their tingles and have time for a longer session before sleep.

Start with "[ASMR] You Are an iPad" for a long whispering roleplay that eases you into sleep. "[ASMR] Walter White Teaches You How to Cook - A Binaural Breaking Bad Role Play" is shorter and binaural, a quick test of whether the character format works for you. If you only have twenty minutes, "[ASMR] Binaural Joker" gives you a compact binaural roleplay.

Skip it if you want pure trigger sounds without talking, since whispering and speaking fill most of the catalog, or if you dislike roleplays built on dark or villainous characters. Instead, look for a channel that is mostly silent tapping or brushing, or one with short, plain trigger videos and no narrative.

Our catalog holds 136 of their videos, uploaded between 2014 and 2026, so it is a broad sample rather than the whole channel.

maxence-rodier-asmr.name: Maxence Rodier | ASMR
maxence-rodier-asmr.bio:
Quiet sessions built around objects: page turning, spraying, folding, typing, and long stretches of no talking at all. Videos usually run around forty minutes, and most go past half an hour, so this is a channel for people who want one long, uninterrupted listen rather than a quick clip. It suits listeners who settle in for sleep or a full study block and prefer silence to whispered commentary.

Start with ASMR Mechanical KEYBOARD Typing Sounds NO TALKING for SLEEP if you want to test the silent approach in under twenty minutes. For the page turning that runs through much of the catalog, try ASMR PAGE TURNING Old Book, Comic Book & Magazine NO TALKING, which sits in the middle of the usual length. If you want the longest single listen here, Crinkly Antique Books Page Turning to Relax/Study to runs close to an hour.

Skip it if you need a voice: almost everything is silent, and the whispering that does appear is rare. Skip it too if you dislike water and spray sounds, which turn up in a handful of videos. Look instead for a channel with soft spoken commentary or roleplay, or one that mixes short clips with long ones, since nothing here is under ten minutes.

Our catalog holds only 27 of their videos, a sample of the channel, with uploads spanning 2014 to 2025.

mia-asmr.name: Mia ASMR
mia-asmr.bio:
Mostly close whispering, often with personal attention roleplays like school nurse checks, face painting and getting you ready for sleep. Videos usually run around 21 minutes. It suits listeners who want a soft, close voice and gentle attention without a very long commitment.

Start with ASMR slow & gentle personal attention + face tracing + clicky whispering to test whether the close whisper style works for you. If you are winding down for bed, ASMR friend helps get you ready for a good sleep! adds counting and calm attention. For a simple roleplay, ASMR school nurse check up keeps to close whispering and personal attention.

Skip it if you want long videos for the whole night, because few uploads pass half an hour. Skip it too if gum chewing or fake eating sounds bother you, since a few roleplays use them. Chels ASMR pairs whispering with long back scratching sessions, and Hatomugi ASMR offers longer Japanese whispering and ear sounds.

Our catalog holds 307 of their videos, uploaded between 2017 and 2026.

morpheus-asmr.bio:

There is some whispering, especially during card openings, but the main event is the sound of someone eating and drinking, sometimes with a beer. It suits listeners who want a long, uninterrupted session of mouth sounds and are happy to have a voice now and then.

Start with ASMR Eating Mochi Ice Cream for the first time, which is a shorter introduction to the eating sounds at twenty three minutes. Skip this channel if you dislike eating sounds, since they dominate almost every video, or if you prefer short clips, as nothing here is under ten minutes. Instead, look for a creator who focuses on whispering or tapping without food, or one who offers short, silent trigger videos.

We have 101 of their videos in our catalog, uploaded between 2018 and 2026, which gives a broad view of the channel's long-form eating content.

relax-my-dog-relaxing-music-for-dogs-asm.bio:
This is a channel built for dogs left alone, not for people winding down. What you hear is mostly nature and ocean sound under calm music, with rain in a smaller share of videos, and every video in our catalog runs well past half an hour, so a session covers a whole workday or a night. Nothing here is whispered or spoken to the viewer. It suits owners who want something to leave playing for a pet during fireworks, storms or long absences.

Start with TV for Dogs! How to Relax My Dog TV with Calming Music!, which layers rain sound over a long stretch and is the easiest first test of whether your dog settles to it. Deep Sleep Relaxing Music for Dogs! [NO ADS] runs twenty hours of ocean sound, useful if you want one file for an overnight. Relaxing Music for Dogs to calm from Fireworks, loud noises includes desensitising sound effects, so try it before a known noisy night rather than during one.

Skip it if you are looking for sounds made for human ears: there is no tapping, no whispering and no roleplay, and the titles address the dog rather than you. The videos are also extremely long, which is awkward if you want a short session. Look instead for a channel of shorter nature or rain recordings aimed at people, or one that mixes gentle talking with the sound.

Our catalog holds 171 of their videos, uploaded between 2016 and 2025, and the unusual thing in our data is that every one of them is long form.

rose-asmr.name: Rose ASMR
rose-asmr.bio:
Mouth sounds and close whispering, with some eating sounds and tingly words in several languages. Videos usually run around 24 minutes. It suits listeners who enjoy close, crisp mouth sounds and like hearing whispers in Spanish, Portuguese and other languages.

Start with ASMR Mesmerizing Tascam Mouth Sounds (no talking) to test whether the mouth sounds work for you without words. If you like hearing languages, ASMR Korean Girl Whispering in Spanish is a calm whisper session. For trigger words, ASMR Mic Tickles & Tingly Portuguese Words mixes mic sounds with soft Portuguese. Each one is a normal evening length, so you can try a couple in one sitting and compare how the mouth sounds and whispers feel.

Skip it if mouth sounds bother you, because they show up in a large share of uploads. Skip it too if eye attention roleplays make you uneasy, since several titles repeat that theme. Anny ASMR offers stronger mouth sounds with Spanish titles, and Lin ASMR keeps mouth sounds even closer to the mic.

Our catalog holds 126 of their videos, uploaded between 2021 and 2026.

rynsey-asmr.name: Rynsey ASMR
rynsey-asmr.bio:
Whispering and tapping with fast hand sounds, playful exams and long live streams. Videos usually run around 25 minutes, though the live sessions go for hours. It suits listeners who like quick, upbeat triggers with a friendly whisper, and want the option of a long stream for sleep.

Start with A Completely Pointless ASMR Exam to test whether the playful exam style works for you in a normal length video. If you want to fall asleep, ASMR Fast Triggers for Sleep and Tingles is a long stream that keeps the triggers coming. For a calmer vibe, ASMR for Chill People ONLY. is another long stream with a slower feel.

Skip it if fast triggers make you restless, because speed is a theme across many titles. Skip it too if you dislike live streams, since several long uploads are past streams with breaks and chat. Chels ASMR offers slow back scratching and soft whispering instead, and ASMR Darya mixes touch triggers with calm whispering.

Our catalog holds 331 of their videos, uploaded between 2021 and 2026.

sio-asmr.name: SIO ASMR
sio-asmr.bio:
Almost every video here is eating sounds: crunchy honey jelly candy, chewy rice cakes, fire noodles and seafood, eaten close to the mic. Videos usually run around 13 minutes, with Korean titles and very little talking. It suits listeners who love crisp, sticky chewing and want a short session.

Start with ASMR MUKBANG | 직접 만든 갤럭시 꿀젤리 블루 디저트 아이스크림 먹방 & 레시피 DESSERT GALAXY HONEY JELLY CANDY if you want the crunchy candy sounds the channel returns to again and again. Try the FIRE NOODLES AND Tteokbokki EATING video with cheese and hot dogs next for softer, chewier food. If you have a little more time, the rainbow version of the galaxy honey jelly dessert runs longer than most uploads here.

Skip it if chewing and swallowing sounds bother you, because there is almost nothing else on the channel, and long sleep videos are rare. GONGSAM TABLE 이공삼 is another Korean eating channel if you want a different set of foods, and 설기양SULGI leans more toward chicken, noodles and convenience store meals.

Our catalog holds 913 of their videos, uploaded between 2019 and 2026.

semide-asmr.name: Semide ASMR
semide-asmr.bio:
Semide ASMR is built around hair play and scalp checks, often with a guest sitting still while the camera follows hands, sticks and brushes through their hair. Videos are long, typically close to an hour, and most include soft talking rather than silence. It suits listeners who want an unhurried session that lasts through a nap or a full night.

Start with "The Ultimate ASMR Scalp Check with Sticks Compilation" if you want a single video that runs for hours and can play until morning. For a shorter taste of the hair play focus, try "[ASMR] Scalp Check & Massage @calmmoonasmr Tracing the Back, Gua Sha & Feather Work (Real Person)" at under an hour. If you prefer a medical roleplay frame, "[ASMR] Real Person Head to Toe Physical Assessment with @ediyasmr" gives you a soft spoken exam in under an hour.

Skip this channel if you dislike long videos, since almost all run past half an hour, or if you want pure sound with no talking, as most include soft speaking. Look instead for a channel with short, silent trigger videos or one focused on tapping and brushing without roleplay.

We have 111 Semide ASMR videos in our catalog, uploaded between 2020 and 2026.

shiatsu-shane-asmr-massage.name: Shiatsu Shane - ASMR Massage
shiatsu-shane-asmr-massage.bio:
Almost entirely real massage on camera: back, shoulders, full body and some hair play, with very little talking. Videos usually run around half an hour, and about half go longer. It suits listeners who like the sound and sight of hands working through a massage rather than whispered roleplay.

Start with "Deep Tissue ASMR Massage for Sleep", a mid-length video that shows whether slow massage sounds help you settle. If they do, "Sleep & Let Go | Deeply Relaxing Full Body Massage ASMR" runs close to two hours, long enough to fall asleep to without the video ending. For a shorter back-focused session, "Melting Intense Back Tension: Deep Tissue ASMR for Sleep" keeps the same quiet pace.

Skip it if you want triggers like tapping, whispering or personal attention roleplay, because nearly every video here is hands-on massage of another person. ASMR Anil Çakmak also centers on massage, but mostly barber shop head massages in shorter videos. Birol Erdin ASMR is another massage choice with a different setting.

Our catalog holds 716 of their videos, uploaded between 2019 and 2026.

sister-sister-asmr.name: Sister Sister ASMR
sister-sister-asmr.bio:
Whispering and hair play fill most videos, and they run long: around half an hour or more, with none under ten minutes. The tone is soft spoken and close, often with personal attention like scalp checks or back tracing. It suits listeners who want a long, quiet session with a person nearby, not just sound effects.

Start with ASMR Perfectionist Sister Gives Scalp Check for its hair play and length, good for settling into sleep. ASMR Back Tracing Game w White Board is another long one, with drawing and whispering to keep your hands and ears busy. If you want to test the whispering first, try ASMR Perfectionist Hair Styling Sleek Ponytail, a shorter session focused on hair fixing.

Skip it if you dislike roleplay scenarios like skin exams or lice checks, or if you need short clips, since nothing here is under ten minutes. Instead, look for a channel with plain sound triggers and no talking, or one with short five minute videos for quick breaks.

We have 69 of their videos in our catalog, uploaded between 2024 and 2026.

sleep-soundly-rain-asmr.name: Sleep Soundly Rain
sleep-soundly-rain-asmr.bio:
Rain on a camper van window, sometimes with thunder, played for hours with no talking. The median video runs over ten hours. It suits listeners who want one steady sound to cover the whole night, or background for study.

Start with Camping Car Window Rain Sounds for Sleeping and Thunder Sounds to Sleep Fast if you like a little thunder with the rain. For heavier rain, Heavy Rain on Camping Car Window for Deep Sleep is louder and fuller. If you want the plainest version, Deep Sleep with Rain Sounds on Camping Car Window keeps to rain alone. All three run for many hours, so you can start one at bedtime and leave it playing until morning.

Skip it if you want tingles, whispering or variety, because every video is the same kind of rain sound. Skip it too if thunder startles you, since some uploads include it. Dido ASMR offers long tapping sessions with soft talking, and Jinx ASMR has shorter whispered sleep videos.

Our catalog holds 222 of their videos, uploaded between 2023 and 2026.
