sleepy-rain-asmr.name: Sleepy Rain
sleepy-rain-asmr.bio:
Every video here is rain, often heavy rain on a tent or car roof, and every one runs for hours rather than minutes. There is no talking, just weather and the occasional rumble of thunder. It suits listeners who want to set one long track at bedtime and forget about it until morning.

Start with Night in a tent with heavy rain and thunder for a full night of steady rain and thunder. If you want something shorter, try Instant deep sleep in a tent with continuous heavy rain and the sound of thunder in the forest, which runs about four hours. For a change of scene, Overnight in the car during heavy rain and thunderstorms for sleep and relaxation puts the rain on a car roof instead of canvas.

Skip this channel if you prefer short sessions or need variety in your triggers, since almost everything is rain and every video is over half an hour. Also skip it if you want guided relaxation or soft speaking, because there are no voices here. Instead, look for a channel that mixes rain with other sounds like tapping or whispering, or one that offers shorter rain videos for quick breaks.

solitary-asmr.name: Solitary ASMR
solitary-asmr.bio:
Mostly soft-spoken videos with whispering, mic scratching and lotion sounds, often with lofi audio and sometimes fast and aggressive. Videos usually run around half an hour. It suits listeners who like a chatty, playful voice with mixed triggers rather than silence.

Start with "ASMR - Random Trigger Assortment w/ Bracelet Sounds (Soft Spoken & Whispered)", which samples several sounds in one video so you can find what works for you. For a calmer listen, "ASMR - LOFI Positive Affirmations, Skin Scratching, and Repeating Words | Whispered" pairs gentle words with scratching. If you like show-and-tell, "ASMR - LOFI Soft Spoken What's in My Purse?! :O" is mostly relaxed talking.

Skip it if you want no talking, since most videos have a voice throughout, or if lofi or messy sound effects bother you, because several titles lean into wet or odd noises. Gentle Whispering ASMR offers a slower, more traditional soft-spoken style. cait ASMR is another option for soft spoken personal attention roleplays.

This is a sample of the channel: our catalog holds only 26 of their videos, uploaded between April and October 2026.

sonagi-asmr.name: Sonagi ASMR
sonagi-asmr.bio:
Mostly ear blowing, deep breathing and fluffy mic touching, often with no talking at all. Videos usually run around forty minutes, and many stretch past an hour. It suits listeners who want a long, quiet session to fall asleep to.

Start with "ASMR Ear Blowing & Fluffy Mic Touching | Rode nt5 + Tascam dr40x | Deep Breathing | 2Hr (No Talking)" for a two-hour silent breathing session. For a shorter test, try "ASMR Twin Ear Blowing and Breathing for Sleep | Fluffy Mic | Long & Short Breathing (No Talking)", which runs about half an hour. If you want a mix of brushing and blowing, "ASMR Camera Brushing & Blowing, Breathing, Shh~ for Deep Sleep | 2 Hours | Tascam (No Talking)" adds soft brushing sounds.

Skip it if you dislike breathing sounds, since they appear in about a quarter of the videos, or if you want short clips, as almost none are under ten minutes. Instead, look for a channel with shorter videos and a wider mix of triggers like tapping or scratching.

We have 196 of their videos in our catalog, uploaded between 2019 and 2024.

songbyrd-asmr.name: SongByrd ASMR
songbyrd-asmr.bio:
Only eating sounds: fast food mukbang, close to the mic, with no talking. Nearly every video runs under ten minutes. It suits listeners who want a quick burst of crunching and chewing sounds rather than a long session for sleep, and the channel is still new.

Start with "ASMR RAISING CANES TENDERS MUKBANG EATING SOUNDS", a short video that shows within minutes whether eating sounds work for you. For softer textures, "ASMR SPAGHETTI & MEATBALLS MUKBANG EATING SOUNDS" trades crunch for slurping. If you want more crunch, "ASMR TACO BELL MUKBANG EATING SOUNDS" sticks to fried and crispy food.

Skip it if eating or chewing sounds bother you, since that is all this channel does, or if you want long videos to fall asleep to, because almost all end within a few minutes. SIO ASMR offers similar eating sounds with more variety in food. GONGSAM TABLE is another mukbang option with Korean titles and a different style of meals.

sounds4sleeping-asmr.name: Sounds4Sleeping
sounds4sleeping-asmr.bio:
Weather and water, almost nothing else: rain, thunder, wind, snow, the occasional ocean or sand. Videos run very long, around two and a half hours, and there is no talking in any of them. It suits listeners who want one track to carry them through the night and who prefer storm ambience to voices or tapping.

Start with Thunderstorm At Sea Sounds For Sleeping for the layered rain and ocean wash, long enough to run all night. Thunderstorm & Rain On Tent Sounds For Sleeping puts the rain close and overhead, which works if you want the storm to feel near. Snowstorm Blizzard Wind Sounds For Sleeping drops the rain entirely for wind and snow, useful if rain keeps you alert rather than sleepy.

Skip it if you want variety: nearly everything here is weather, and a listener after whispering, tapping or roleplay will find nothing. Skip it too if you want short sessions, since every video is long and there are no brief clips to sample. Look instead for a channel that mixes rain with other triggers, or one with short videos and talking, depending on what you need.

Our catalog holds only 21 of their videos, a sample of the channel, uploaded between 2017 and 2023.

Try HANDI MUTTON CURRY, HANDI CHICKEN CURRY, LIVER CURRY, EGG CURRY, FISH CURRY for a wider mix of dishes in one sitting. If you prefer sweeter, snappier sounds, ASMR:EATING CHOCOLATE CHOCOLATE PARTY trades curry for chocolate bars and truffles.

Skip it if wet, saucy chewing bothers you, because most uploads are curry and rice eaten with big bites. Skip it too if you want long sleep videos, since almost none pass half an hour. SIO ASMR offers Korean desserts and noodles instead, and GONGSAM TABLE 이공삼 sticks to convenience store meals like fire noodles and hot dogs.

Our catalog holds 629 of their videos, uploaded between 2017 and 2026.

springbok-asmr.name: Springbok ASMR
springbok-asmr.bio:
Soft spoken roleplay and quiet hands-on sound, in videos that usually run well past half an hour. Some are whispered, some are simply a calm voice walking you through a task, and a few are mostly tapping and ear attention. It suits listeners who want a long, story-shaped session to sink into at bedtime rather than a quick burst of triggers.

Start with ASMR Hotel Check-In Roleplay with Typing, Writing, and Paper Sounds for a full-length roleplay built on typing and paper, long enough to carry you to sleep. Binaural ASMR Whisper Library Roleplay with book sounds is the one to try if you want whispering in both ears with page and book sounds around it. If you only have twenty minutes, ASMR Ear Attention with tapping, ear brushing, inaudible whispering, and more is the shortest and most direct way to test whether the close-up sound works for you.

Skip it if you want short clips, since almost everything here is long, or if you dislike talking, because the voice is nearly always present and often carries the whole video. Look instead for a creator whose catalog is mostly silent trigger work under fifteen minutes, or one who stays with pure sound and no roleplay framing.

Our catalog holds 82 of their videos, uploaded between 2014 and 2026, and the unusual thing in it is how strongly the long roleplay format dominates: most sessions run over half an hour, which is rare among the channels we hold.

strawbie-asmr.bio:
This channel is built on mouth sounds, often layered and sometimes paired with tapping, in videos that usually run around twelve minutes. Skip this channel if you dislike eating sounds or mouth sounds in general, since they dominate the catalog. Also skip it if you prefer mostly short videos, because many run under ten minutes and only a few go past thirty. Instead, look for a channel that centers on tapping or whispering with longer, talking-free videos.

talisa-tossell-asmr.bio:
This channel is mostly slime, with a smaller share of eating sounds, and most videos run under ten minutes. The slime clips are silent, with no talking or music, while the eating videos add chewy, crunchy sounds. It suits listeners who want quick, visual relaxation and do not mind a mix of silent slime and food sounds.

Start with "Satisfying Slime ASMR | Relaxing Slime Videos Compilation No Talking No Music No Voiceover" for a twenty minute silent session that works well for winding down. If you want to test the eating sounds, try "I TRIED ASMR // EATING RAW HONEYCOMB, ICE EATING! CHEWY AND CRUNCHY ASMR + TRY NOT TO GET SATISFIED" at ten minutes, or the five minute honeycomb and aloe vera video if you only have a few minutes.

Skip this channel if you dislike eating sounds, since a noticeable portion of the videos are food based, or if you prefer long sessions, as only a few run over thirty minutes. Instead, look for a channel that focuses purely on silent slime with longer compilations, or one with a broader range of triggers and no eating content.

We have 32 of their videos in our catalog, uploaded between 2017 and 2025.

telina-asmr.name: Telina ASMR
telina-asmr.bio:
Clicky whispering and whispered rambles, with tapping and some mouth sounds. Videos usually run around 25 minutes. It suits listeners who like the crisp sound of close whispering and a relaxed chat to fall asleep to.

Start with ASMR, I Whisper, You Sleep [EXTRA Clicky Whisper Ramble] to test whether the clicky whisper works for you. If you want even closer sound, ASMR | EXTRA TINGLY CLOSE WHISPER + CLICKY MOUTH SOUNDS (Sleepy Ramble) adds mouth sounds. For something fun, the video whispering in many different languages lets you find your own. Each runs long enough to settle into, and the rambles keep the voice low and even the whole way through, which helps if you want company while you fall asleep.

Skip it if you dislike mouth sounds or clicky consonants, because they run through most uploads. Skip it too if you want silence, since nearly every video has whispering. ASMR Annie offers long, inaudible whispering with nails, and Rynsey ASMR mixes whispering with fast triggers.

the-healing-word-asmr.name: The Healing Word ASMR
the-healing-word-asmr.bio:
The Healing Word ASMR is a Christian ASMR channel where soft Bible reading, prayers, and gentle sounds like brushing or rain fill very long videos, most running well over an hour. The speaking stays quiet and reassuring throughout. It suits listeners who want a session that keeps going in the background, especially for sleep or quiet comfort during prayer.

Start with "Christian ASMR | Psalm 23 | Cozy Bible Reading" for a long, brushing-led reading that can carry you through the night. "3 Hours Christian Bible Reading, Praying Over You | ASMR with Rain Sounds" adds rain for steady background sound if you want to test how the rain works for you. "Christian ASMR | Let Me Wash, Anoint & Pray Over You" is shorter and more personal, good if you have about an hour and want soft speaking with prayer.

Skip this channel if you prefer short videos or silent triggers without religious content; nearly all videos run past half an hour and many center on Christian prayer and Bible reading. Instead, look for a channel with shorter, secular ASMR sessions or one that focuses on non-verbal sounds like tapping and brushing without spoken prayer.

We have a large sample of their videos in our catalog, uploaded between 2021 and 2026.

tingting-asmr.name: Tingting ASMR
tingting-asmr.bio:
Personal attention, tapping and whispering, with many very long hair treatment and scalp check videos. Videos usually run around half an hour, and many sleep sessions go far longer. It suits listeners who want close, quiet attention that keeps going after they fall asleep.

Start with "[ASMR] Doctor Scalp Check and Treatment", a regular length roleplay that shows whether the scalp and hair sounds work for you. If they do, "[ASMR] Sleep Recovery ~ 3 Hours of Hair Treatments" is long enough to cover a full night without the video ending. Starting with the shorter one first saves you a long commitment to a style that may not suit you.

Skip it if you want short videos or no talking, since most sessions are long, voiced roleplays with a soft voice guiding you through each step. Rapunzel ASMR offers similar personal attention and hair play in shorter videos, often binaural. Goodnight Moon is another option for gentle, slower roleplays.

Our catalog holds 149 of their videos, uploaded between 2017 and 2026.

tranquillily-asmr.name: TranquilLily ASMR
tranquillily-asmr.bio:
Soft spoken voice, gloves, and ear cleaning tools, in videos that run long: most pass the half hour mark and a few stretch past an hour. Nothing here is silent, and the pace is slow and deliberate rather than busy. It suits listeners who want a single long session to sink into at bedtime, not a quick burst of sounds.

Start with "ASMR - Intense Ear Pressure - Otoscope, Suction, Mic Pressing - Gloves - Soft Spoken" for a half hour taste of the ear-focused style. "ASMR - Long, Intense Ear Cleaning Roleplay - Full Service Ear Spa - Soft Spoken with Gloves" runs over an hour if you want to stay in one scene without choosing again. "ASMR - Ear Cleaning One Ear at a Time - In the Attic! - Gloves, Soft-Spoken" works if you like a setting and a bit of story around the sounds.

Skip it if you need short clips, since only one video in the catalog is under ten minutes, or if you dislike close-up ear cleaning and glove sounds, which dominate the titles. Look instead for a channel built on silent triggers, or one with short ten minute sessions for a quick wind-down.

Our catalog holds 345 of their videos, uploaded between 2015 and 2026, and the unusual thing is how few of them are short: the whole sample is long-form.

ultimate-ambient-noise-soundzzz-asmr.name: Ultimate Ambient Noise Soundzzz
ultimate-ambient-noise-soundzzz-asmr.bio:
This channel is almost entirely rain, with a little nature sound, and the videos are long: most run around eleven hours. There is no talking, just steady rain and sometimes thunder. It suits listeners who want to set one video at bedtime and forget about it until morning.

Start with Thunderstorm at Sea with Heavy Rain for its continuous rain and thunder, which masks background noise all night. RAIN SOUNDS IN THE WOODS is similar but with a softer woodland feel, good if you find thunder too sharp. Fall Asleep with Soothing Rain Sounds is another long one, useful if you want rain without extra elements.

Skip this channel if you prefer short sessions or variety; every video here is over ten hours and nearly all are rain. Also, if you dislike thunder, many titles include it, so check before playing. Instead, look for channels with shorter videos and a mix of triggers like tapping or whispering.

Our catalog holds only 29 of their videos, uploaded between 2016 and 2020, so this is a sample of the channel.

vainsz-asmr.name: Vainsz
vainsz-asmr.bio:
Keyboard typing sounds over gaming footage, almost all short. Most videos finish in under ten minutes, with mechanical keyboard clicks layered over gameplay. It suits listeners who like keyboard sounds or gaming and want a quick, focused clip rather than a sleep session.

Start with Steelseries Apex Pro ASMR Chill, Satisfying Keyboard Fortnite to test whether keyboard clicks over gameplay work for you. Try the Razer Huntsman Mini ASMR Chill upload to hear a different switch feel. If you want something longer than usual, Dreamhack + Endgame Highlights (Steelseries Apex Pro ASMR) runs a little past the typical length.

Skip it if you want sounds for sleep, whispering or calm visuals, because the footage is fast gameplay and the videos are short. Skip it too if you are not into keyboards, since there is nothing else here, and the catalog stops in 2024. ASMR PPOMO offers long keyboard typing sessions with no talking for study, and Vito ASMR is another option to compare.

Our catalog holds 456 of their videos, uploaded between 2020 and 2024.

vanukee-asmr.bio:
French language videos mixing tapping, tastings, makeup and spa roleplays, plus long trigger collections for sleep. Most uploads run past half an hour, with a median around 47 minutes. It suits French speakers who want long, gentle sessions with a friendly voice.

Start with the rain on the skylight trigger video, Cette vidéo va t'endormir à coup sûr, if you want to fall asleep, since it layers many triggers with rain. Skip it if you do not follow French, since most videos include talking, or if you want short clips, because few uploads are under ten minutes. vito-asmr.name: Vito ASMR
vito-asmr.bio:
Very long compilations of tapping, keyboard typing, water, wood, ice and kinetic sand, with Korean and English titles and little or no talking. The median video runs around 82 minutes, and many go for hours. It suits listeners who want a soft, steady sound bed for a full night of sleep or a long study session.

Start with ASMR For People Who Need SLEEP if your ears are sensitive, since the Korean title promises no sharp sounds. If you like liquid sounds, ASMR Relaxing Water Sounds for Sleep runs for hours of clear, gentle water. For something more textured, ASMR Most Satisfying Kinetic Sand Triggers for Sleep focuses on sand cutting and crumbling.

Skip it if you want short videos or a voice to follow, because almost everything is long and wordless. Skip it too if you like personal attention roleplays, since there are almost none here. Eevy ASMR offers shorter tapping and scratching on unusual surfaces, and asmr zeitgeist has similar long, no talking tapping compilations.

Our catalog holds 354 of their videos, uploaded between 2019 and 2026.

whisperaudios-asmr.name: WhisperAudios ASMR
whisperaudios-asmr.bio:
Mostly whispering, often in doctor exams and grooming roleplays with ear to ear binaural sound. Videos usually run around 28 minutes. It suits listeners who like calm, whispered medical roleplays and close attention.

Start with ASMR, Inaudible/Unintelligible Up-Close Breathy Whispering to test whether the whisper style works for you without a story. If you like roleplays, ASMR, Annual Physical Exam with Dr. Hastings is a slow, whispered exam. For grooming, ASMR, Mens Hair Cut Roleplay uses binaural attention from ear to ear. Each one keeps the whisper low and steady, and none of them rushes, so they work well as a slow evening listen. The exam videos also give a clear structure to follow if your mind tends to wander.

Skip it if medical exams make you uneasy, because many roleplays use them. Skip it too if you want tapping or no talking, since a whisper runs through nearly everything. Mia ASMR offers shorter whispered personal attention, and Telina ASMR leans on clicky whispering and rambles.

Our catalog holds 300 of their videos, uploaded between 2015 and 2026.

whispering-willow-asmr.name: Whispering Willow ASMR
whispering-willow-asmr.bio:
Whispering Willow ASMR is mostly whispering and positive affirmations, with videos that often run around half an hour or longer. The tone is gentle and encouraging, and many videos include talking rather than being silent. It suits listeners who want a calm, supportive voice to help them relax or fall asleep, especially if they enjoy affirmations and personal attention.

Start with "ASMR Cozy and Safe Affirmations For Sleep (low light, mic brushing)" for a shorter introduction to the affirmation style. If you prefer a longer session, try "ASMR 2 HOURS Cozy Personal Attention and Pampering Compilation" for an extended pampering experience. For something more structured, "ASMR Follow My Directions to Sleep | Eyes Closed, Guided Meditation, Light Triggers" offers a guided meditation that can help quiet a busy mind.

Skip this channel if you dislike talking or prefer silent triggers, since many videos include spoken affirmations and guidance. Also, if you want mostly short clips, note that only a few videos are under ten minutes. Instead, look for a channel that focuses on silent triggers like tapping or brushing, or one with shorter videos if that fits your routine better.

Our catalog includes only 29 of their videos, uploaded between 2021 and 2026, so this is a sample of the channel.

whispersred-asmr.name: WhispersRed ASMR
whispersred-asmr.bio:
WhispersRed ASMR is mostly long-form, with videos that often run over half an hour and many that stretch past three hours. You'll hear whispering, personal attention, tapping, and fabric sounds, sometimes with soft speaking and sometimes in silence. It suits listeners who want to settle in for a full evening or a whole night of background sound, not a quick fix.

For a first listen, try "ASMR Back Tracing w/ Scratch, Brushing, Buds & Oil Massage" if you want a focused session with close personal attention. "Sleep Time Tucking You In" is a gentle roleplay for winding down at bedtime. And "3.5 HOURS Fabric Sounds NO TALKING" is there for anyone who prefers no voices at all and wants hours of steady sound.

Skip this channel if you dislike long videos, since almost all are over half an hour, or if you want lots of short clips to sample. Also, if you need constant talking, many videos here are quiet or silent. Instead, look for creators who specialize in short, frequent uploads or who talk throughout.

Our catalog includes 43 of their videos, spanning from late 2014 to late 2025.

zoey-asmr.name: ZOEY ASMR 조이
zoey-asmr.bio:
Short, crunchy eating videos: enoki mushrooms in black bean sauce, baby octopus, honeycomb, jelly noodles and candy. Most uploads finish in under ten minutes, and titles mix Korean, English and Japanese. It suits listeners who want a quick burst of chewing sounds rather than a long wind down.

Start with ASMR BLACK BEAN ENOKI MUSHROOMS BABY OCTOPUS TRUFFLE BLACK BEAN NOODLES for the squeaky mushroom, chewy octopus and slurpy noodle sounds the channel keeps coming back to. Try ASMR RAW HONEYCOMB TAPIOCA PEARLS if sticky, waxy textures are what you are after. If you only have a few minutes and like hard candy crunch, ASMR Edible Tools Chocolate is short and has no talking.

Skip it if you need a long video for sleep, since nearly all uploads are short, or if eating sounds are not for you, because there is very little else. There is no whispering or guided relaxation to fall back on. Spice ASMR is another eating channel to compare, and GONGSAM TABLE 이공삼 tends toward fuller meals.

Our catalog holds 998 of their videos, uploaded between 2018 and 2026.

Start with "ASMR MUKBANG BLACK BEAN FIRE NOODLES & CHICKEN NUGGETS (No Talking) EATING SOUNDS", a short video that tells you quickly whether eating sounds work for you. Skip it if eating or chewing sounds bother you, because they lead nearly every video, or if you want whispering, tapping or a calm sleep video. JaeYeol ASMR offers similar close-mic eating with Korean titles. Hongyu ASMR is another mukbang option with a different menu and pace.

asmr-zeitgeist.bio:

Start with ASMR for People Who Don't Get Tingles if you think you are immune, since it is a shorter, focused test. For a full night, ASMR Turquoise Triggers for Sleep [No Talking] runs for hours of color themed tapping. If tapping is not your thing, the XXL Brushing & Brushes ONLY Compilation [NO TALKING] switches to soft brush sounds.

Skip it if you want roleplay, whispering or short videos, because nearly everything is long and silent. Skip it too if ear cleaning sounds bother you, since one compilation is built on them. Eevy ASMR does tapping and scratching outdoors in shorter videos, and Dido ASMR adds soft talking with card games. There is little variety in pace.

certified-mood-asmr.name: certified mood
certified-mood-asmr.bio:
Mostly hair play and whispering, in videos that often run around thirty five minutes or longer. Many are soft spoken or silent, and the feel is close and attentive, like having your hair brushed by someone who is not in a hurry. It suits listeners who want a long, quiet session before sleep and do not mind a male whisper voice.

Start with "ASMR | Hair Brushing, Scalp and Shoulder Massage for Relaxation and Sleep | No Talking Real Person" for a silent, hands on hair play session that is easy to fall asleep to. "ASMR | Back Inspection, Measuring, Drawing, Testing Energy Flow | Soft Spoken Male | Real Person" is a soft spoken roleplay with a calm, methodical pace if you want some talking. "ASMR | Bantu Knots w/ Braiding Extensions Hairstyle" is a very long whispered hair styling video for when you have time to settle in.

Skip it if you want short videos, since almost none are under ten minutes, or if you dislike a male whisper voice and roleplay framing. Instead, look for channels with shorter sessions, more variety in triggers, or a female voice if that is your preference.

We have 142 of their videos in our catalog, uploaded between 2020 and 2024.

sanriolve-asmr.bio:
Slime and typing sounds, mostly, with videos that run around eighteen minutes but swing between very short clips and long compilations. There is no talking to speak of, and the focus stays on hands and fidget boards rather than roleplay. It suits listeners who want something to fiddle with in the background and who like the idea of a channel that can fill either a few minutes or a couple of hours.

Start with the ten minute fidget board comparison if you want a quick test of whether the slime and board sounds work for you. For a full evening or a long sleep session, the long rating compilation is the one to press play on. If you would rather sample the shorter end first, the five minute favorite boards video is a low commitment listen.

Skip it if you need whispering or soft spoken guidance, because this channel is almost entirely object sounds with no voice. Skip it too if you dislike slime and sticky textures, since that is the core of most videos. Look instead for a channel built around whispered roleplay or gentle talking if you want a voice in the room, or a pure tapping channel if slime is not for you.

Our catalog holds 48 of their videos, uploaded between 2023 and 2026.

nz-ambience-asmr.name: 낮잠 NZ Ambience
nz-ambience-asmr.bio:
Most videos here are long ambience pieces, often an hour and a half, built around quiet sounds like rain, fire, the ocean, or the scratch of a brush. Some are wordless soundscapes, some carry soft Korean whispering, and a few are study sessions with a timer and classical music. It suits listeners who want something running in the background for a long stretch, whether for sleep, study, or just filling a silent room.

For falling asleep, try the three hour Rainy Café de Philosophie, which gives you an unbroken stretch of soft rain. If you want whispering woven into a scene, 너를 증명해 보이거라 is a ninety minute medieval princess study ambience with soft speech. And if you need to focus right now, 그만 미룹시다 sets a forty five minute timer with thunder and classical music, though the title warns it is not ASMR.

Skip it if you want short clips or frequent uploads, since nearly everything runs past half an hour and the catalog spans only a handful of years. Skip it too if you dislike Korean narration mixed into ambience, or if you want pure trigger sounds without music or scene setting. Look instead for a channel of short, silent tapping and whispering videos, or one that posts frequently and keeps sessions under ten minutes.

Our catalog holds 34 of their videos, uploaded between late 2019 and mid 2026, so this is a sample of the channel rather than everything they have made.

camping-film-asmr.bio:
Rain on a tent, wind, and the hush of a campsite, with almost no talking. The videos are mostly in Korean titles but the sound is universal, and they run around half an hour, with a few much longer. It suits listeners who want a long, steady rain session for sleep or deep relaxation.

Start with RAIN and STORM Camping in AIR TENT that is more cozy and relaxing than home. ASMR for a full half hour of rain and storm to fall asleep to. If you want to test the snow version, try -16°C | SNOW and STORM Camping in AIR TENT that is more cosy and relaxing than home, which adds wind and snow for a colder feel. For a shorter listen, Solo Camping in Heavy Rain Forest | Landslide warning due to heavy rain | Rain sound ASMR runs just over twenty minutes and still gives you the forest rain.

Skip it if you need variety in triggers, because nearly everything here is rain and camping. Also skip if you dislike titles with storm or landslide warnings, which may feel intense. Instead, look for a channel with a mix of indoor triggers like tapping or whispering, or one with shorter videos if you only have ten minutes.

We have 77 of their videos in our catalog, uploaded between 2022 and 2026.

dangbee-eating-asmr.name: 당비 Dangbee EATING
dangbee-eating-asmr.bio:
Eating sounds with colorful emoji themed foods and clear jelly desserts, from tiny clips to hour long compilations. Videos usually run around 11 minutes, with very short clips mixed in alongside some long ones. It suits listeners who like crunchy, glassy jelly sounds and want either a quick burst or a long eating compilation.

Start with asmr CLEAR EMOJI FOOD JELLY to test whether the crisp, clear jelly sounds work for you in a few minutes. If you want something for sleep, the emoji food challenge for sleep relaxing compilation runs about ten minutes and stays calm. For longer listening, asmr COLORFUL EMOJI FOOD CHALLENGE MUKBANG moves through many colors and textures.

Skip it if you dislike chewing sounds, because nothing else appears here, or if very short clips feel too abrupt. Some uploads are sped up, which can feel busy. SIO ASMR offers similar honey jelly desserts in standard length videos, and GONGSAM TABLE 이공삼 focuses on savory Korean meals.

Our catalog holds 309 of their videos, uploaded between 2023 and 2026.

sulgi-asmr.name: 설기양SULGI
sulgi-asmr.bio:
This is an eating channel through and through: homemade fried chicken, fire noodles, tteokbokki, kimbap and sausages, chewed close to the mic. Most videos run around 14 minutes and almost none are shorter than ten. It suits listeners who want hearty, saucy food sounds rather than candy crunch.

Start with the CHEETOS CHICKEN AND BLACK BEAN NOODLES video to hear the crispy coating and slurpy noodles side by side. If spicy food sounds are your thing, the SAUSAGES AND FIRE NOODLES EATING upload keeps things simple with just a few foods. For more variety in one sitting, try the Convenience Store Food EATING video with tteokbokki, chicken, kimbap and dessert.

Skip it if you want whispering, talking or anything long enough to fall asleep to, because the channel almost never leaves the table and long videos are missing. SIO ASMR covers similar ground with more candy and jelly desserts, and 당비 Dangbee EATING is another eating channel to compare.

Our catalog holds 1002 of their videos, uploaded between 2019 and 2026.

soribaguni-asmr.name: 소리바구니 SoriBaguni ASMR
soribaguni-asmr.bio:
This channel is built almost entirely from fire and rain, recorded in long, quiet sessions that run for hours rather than minutes. There is no talking in the titles and no roleplay framing, just crackling wood, falling water and the occasional cat or tent in the scene. It suits listeners who want to set something playing and forget about it until morning.

Start with 비오는날 시골 아궁이 장작 - 빗소리 장작타는 소리 fireplace rain relaxing, which pairs rain with a burning stove and runs about four hours, so it covers a whole night. If you want the longest single stretch, 텐트안에서 듣는 편안한 빗소리 8시간 | 우중캠핑 ASMR gives you eight hours of rain from inside a tent. For a softer, more open sound, 공원에 내리는 부드러운 빗소리 | 불면증과 숙면을 위한 백색소음 ASMR is rain in a park without the fire underneath it.

Skip it if you need whispering, tapping or personal attention, because this channel offers almost none of that, and skip it if you want short clips, since every video here runs well past half an hour. Look instead for a creator who mixes rain with soft spoken voice or roleplay, or one who posts ten minute trigger sessions you can fit into a break.

Our catalog holds only 19 of their videos, a sample of the channel, with uploads dated from 2022 to 2026.

tv-wow-beauty-asmr.name: 와뷰티TV | Wow Beauty ASMR
tv-wow-beauty-asmr.bio:
Mostly massage sessions filmed inside real spa and care shops, with Korean titles and almost no talking. Videos usually run around half an hour, and many go well past that. It suits listeners who want a long, quiet session that feels like being worked on rather than spoken to, and who are happy to let one video run while they drift off.

Start with the 골반비대칭 스트레칭 massage if you want a full session for falling asleep. The men's nail care video is a shorter, quieter test of the personal attention style, useful if you only have twenty minutes. For a very long unwind, try the 두피마사지 and 헤드스파 session.

Skip it if you want short clips, since none are under ten minutes, or if you need talking to settle. Instead, look for a channel built around short guided whisper videos or soft speaking, where a voice carries the session rather than hands and shop ambience.

We have 90 of their videos in our catalog, uploaded between 2023 and 2026.
